Author: Shekhar Kumar Yadav Bench: Shekhar Kumar Yadav HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Court No. - 68 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 14270 of 2022 Applicant :- Amardeep Singh @ Bhole And 3 Others Opposite Party :- State Of U.P And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Pandey,Lakshmi Kant Pandey,Satya Priya Dwivedi,Utka Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material available on record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by applicants to quash the impugned charge sheet dated 15.12.2020 in Case Crime No. 0591 of 2019, under sections 323, 504, 506, 313,
498A IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Baragaon, District Varanasi as well as cognizance order dated 7.10.2021 passed by learned Additional A.C.J.M. Vth, Varanasi.
During arguments, learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that he does not want to press the prayer for quashing of the above mentioned case.

His sole prayer is that a direction may be issued to the court below to decide the bail application of the applicants in view of the judgment in the case Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC Amardeep Singh @ Bhole And 3 Others vs State Of U.P And Another on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102071640/
1 922.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC Amardeep Singh @ Bhole And 3 Others vs State Of U.P And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the present application is disposed of with the direction that in case the applicants filed bail application before the court below, the same shall be heard and disposed of expeditiously by the court below in view of the settled law laid by this Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (Supra).
With the above observations, this application u/s 482 is disposed of finally.

Order Date :- 16.2.2023 A.
